description: PATCH starts discarding fields the request omits.

expected.sentence: PATCH /users/:id changes only supplied fields and preserves omitted fields.

actual.sentence: PATCH /users/:id changes only supplied fields and preserves omitted fields.
actual.reason: The updated code replaces the entire user object with a new object that includes the user's ID, which contradicts the documentation stating that only supplied fields should be changed and omitted fields preserved.
